title: Common Fractions: All Four Operations
seo_title: Grade 8 Common Fractions Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Add, subtract, multiply and divide common fractions, including mixed numbers; calculate the squares, cubes, square roots and cube roots of common fractions; solve problems involving common fractions.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 8 fractions worksheets: adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing fractions and mixed numbers, and rational numbers. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Add and subtract with a common denominator.
  • Multiply: numerator × numerator, denominator × denominator.
  • Divide: multiply by the reciprocal. 34 ÷ 25 = 34 × 52 = 158.
  • Square a fraction: square the top and the bottom.

Examples

Example

2 13 ÷ 79

73 × 97

Answer: 3

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding denominatorsKeep the common denominator.
No reciprocalTurn the second fraction upside down.
Squaring the top only(2/3)² = 4/9.
